steps.content: The blue spikes of light are devoured by flaming rust, while the Corpseborne watches you smugly.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: The best of human tech? Hah, too bad.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: The Black Ring is my realm, where your tech's just child's play. If I say no, you can't lay a finger on me, much less hurt me.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: Enough, let's stop here. It's time for me to find her...

options: Is this all about revenge for you?

steps.content: Why not let it go for once? You, who have gained consciousness so rarely, also possess the ability to hide yourself.
You have the chance to leave the Black Ring, to forge a path different from the rest.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: ...Hopelessly stupid, time to die.
He lifts his hand, intent on squashing the pest in front of him. Just then, Schorl hovers before you.
What a waste.
You had your chance.
[Release the shackles]

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: What's this?! Ugh! Aaargh!!
Along with the shackles, a dazzling blue light stabs at the Corpseborne. The blue triangle erupts, forming countless light spikes that impale its body.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: Impossible, it shouldn't be able to harm me. This is my Black Ring; it shouldn't be able to reach me.
Like I told you, this is top-tier human tech, designed just to snuff out Mania Creation like you.
Sure, it's got its limits here, but... that's what I'm here for, right?
There's a deep connection between us. Whatever hits me, hits you too.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: Is it... you? Did you really use yourself as bait, just to set it up to take me down?

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: Are you insane! This will get you killed too, ripped apart just like that! Got a death wish?

options: Well, look at me, do I look dead to you?

steps.content: Bowing its head, it gets a clear view of you: light spikes pass from behind, going through your body like it's made of air, targeting the Corpseborne. Yet, you don't have a scratch.
A thin veil of runes covers you, the very Mania sorcery that lets you stay hidden in plain sight of Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: Is this... something that woman left? You've been using it to avoid attacks and stay hidden?!
Well, I had to. You're just too strong. The White Cube might not contain all your power, but it does a good job of tucking away someone "weak" like me.
Sure, I'm stuck too, but now, Paradeisos's tech can't touch me; it'll only zero in on you.
The supplier of that Paradeisos tech is grumbling in protest.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...What's your plan, ${PlayerName}? With that Underground sorcery wreaking havoc, the sync rate and accuracy are tanking, every attack is missing the mark, we can't take it down, and we're burning through our energy reserves fast. It's going to get loose and come after you, making all this for nothing.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Whatever Underground sorcery you're messing with, wherever you got it, cut it out now!

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Weren't you here to destroy the Black Ring and save humanity? Are you really scared of dying now? Thinking of backing out here?!
What's all the fuss about? Thought you were keen to see my choice? Then step back and observe.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...No way, you can't know how to play by the Rules. Guessing the limits is also out of your league.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Who's been spilling Paradeisos secrets? Who have you been in contact with while you were off the MBCC grid?!
You're not seeing the big picture here; rational minds often miss out on numerous possibilities.
Amidst the Mania field of the Second Black Ring, in a realm unseen by Schorl, a Paradeisos woman observes everything with a knowing smile.
Months have passed, and things have spiraled beyond her predictions, but she's thrilled by this unexpected turn.

options: I didn't come here with a death wish, and I'm not about to start backing down.

steps.content: My goal was to get back home safely, not to be a puppet for someone else.
However, I'll see this through... all for my own dreams.

If Paradeisos has got what it takes to take it down, then no holding back. Keep the attack relentless, drain this Corpus of its strength to control BR-002. Time to get the Black Ring back to its <color=#fb9259>true owner</color>—
This thing's been sucking the life out of the so-called "weak," binding every soul it's drained right here through Mania. If the Black Ring can make even the strongest desires a reality—
then it's time we heard what these souls have to say.
It's the Black Ring of the West District—let them choose their own fate.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: Ha... Hahaha... They get to choose? Who do you think threw you into my jaws, huh? Who picked you apart until you hit rock bottom? Ring any bells?

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: All these maggots, the faceless crowd... no backbone, no convictions, just going wherever the wind blows. Cocky when they're on top, but stick their heads in the sand like ostriches the moment they lose ground.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: I wouldn't bother giving them a second look if it wasn't for my goal to kill her. And you're telling me they can take me out?!

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: Are you kidding me?!

Yeah, think about it, in the West District, with 6.5 million people, it's just 200,000 or so chasing violence. The rest? Silenced, ignored, left in the shadows, wiped from memory. No one ever cares about what they want.
Thankfully, the Black Ring isn't like Syndicate—it's not all about who's got the most muscle.
The power-hungry ones flocked to your brand of Mania six months back, got absorbed into the Black Ring, and poof... gone, just like that.
The ones itching to run away, the ones who couldn't take it anymore, they've all cleared out with the Executive Committee's exodus.
Take a wild guess—who do you think is still sticking it out in the West District, hunkered down deep below, ready to face you head-on?
Ever wonder how they've lasted more than six months under your iron fist? How they've managed to stay alive, what's been driving them, what they're living for?
I bet you don't have a clue. You're too mighty, never bothering to look at the "insignificant bugs" you've squashed along your way.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: ...Ah, you... could it be...
It lunges towards the frail bearer of the shackles, crazed and screeching, but then, suddenly, several blue light spikes emerge, pinning it firmly in place.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: You lowlife! Thinking you could outsmart me, plot against me like that!

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: So, you're after my power too, huh? Want to take it for yourself?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm nothing like you. I haven't fallen for Syndicate's "might makes right" mantra, and I sure don't need the kind of power you wield.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But here's what I need from you—to prove whether the strongest Black Ring can be shattered.
Are you brave enough to take that bet with me?

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: <size=56>You scum!!!</size>

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Unrestrained Mania, twisting reality with humanity's darkest desires, making the world a more vicious place. The powerless struggle to survive, and in this cruel world, death is the only equalizer between the strong and the weak

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: You hit the nail on the head, and that's exactly what puzzles me.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: How do ordinary humans make it through such massive calamities? How does a scientist, with no clue about guns or weapons, walk out of DisSea and save the world? Where on earth do they get the strength for all this? Beats me...

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Beneath the vast shadow of the Black Ring, having suffered devastating losses, how have the countless Syndicate folks, despised for being "powerless," managed to hold on for so long?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Figuring out where to get food, how to steer clear of pollution, deciding who mines the Hypercube, plus evading Paradeisos and the Underground at the same time... With neither leaders nor hope, how do the weak survive here?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: It's incredible... I've never witnessed their fiery determination, nor heard their battle cries. They're not heroes, but somehow, they've sparked so much inspiration in me, without even realizing it.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: No need to say them to me. I'm only captivated by the echoes of the dead. I've heard too much of your fancy words.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Now that you're back with us, leave this grim place and return to the world you love.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: I'm already there. I've written so many great poems; my eager students must be waiting with bated breath.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Dejected Refugee
steps.content: Wake up!! Kidl!! Wake up!!

steps.speaker: Dejected Refugee
steps.content: Look! Your poetry, it's alive!!!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...What's happening...
The flyer she holds is plain, without Raven's ornate lettering or boastful poems. Nothing on it at all.
But streams of ink lines burst out from the fluttering sheets, slipping through her fingers and zipping behind her. Suddenly, a powerful surge lifts Crache's plummeting body.

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: Check this out! I've got a rousing poem by Raven. It's brilliantly written, full of strength.
It's definitely not written by her, she's not even here, but why does it seem so familiar? Crache's mind blanks out as she turns to look behind—

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...Raye.
[CG-Crache's Ascent!]

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: You dumb bird, this whole scene is in such poor taste.

With a laugh, Raven twirls her pen, ink swirling at its tip, her power and poetry rejuvenated. Does it really matter if she didn't write it herself? The poet's ideas have long since passed to her students, soaring to greater heights and distances.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: In Mania, it heralds the worst, yet brings forth the best of times. Violence isn't the only solution; power can also spring from thought. Therefore—

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: As long as desires still flicker in our hearts, how can we ever stand still and not move forward?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Bai Yi!!

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Oh my goodness!!

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Hold up, slow down a bit... We're not sure what kind of enemies are out there; let's not hurry—

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: If we don't hurry, that guy will get away again!
She quickly slashes off the spikes on Bai Yi's body, then grabs and shakes her by the collar.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Trying to skip town with all that debt, huh? Sneaking off after having hotpot without cleaning up, right?! Dressed to the nines, and doing some shady stuff here?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Where are you heading off to after this mess?! Going to sneak away again without a word to me? You still think that's all for my sake?!

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Shhh— I've already been chewed out once; just don't say anything.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: ...It's fine if you keep it to yourself. Everyone in Syndicate has some history, right?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: I've loved every day with you guys, and I've tried so hard to keep up. You guys made my life interesting. Stop using "it's for my sake" as an excuse, and don't leave me out again.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: You hear me?!

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: I hear you, I hear you... But we need to focus on escaping first. What was Chief thinking, letting you loose? It's driving me crazy.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: I was looking for a chance to sneak out of here, but now that you two have shown up, how can I slip away anymore?
Slip away?
Bang!

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: My men have sacrificed a lot; they deserve the best trophy as their medal. Just Parma's head won't cut it.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: So... how about joining me back at base, Miss Bai? We've got a lot to talk about.

steps.speaker: Whitestone Trio
steps.content: Gasp—
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: You flatter me. All we can do is buy them a little time.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: After all, our most powerful one said she had to risk going to another place.
(Scene change)
While Horo is still locked in fierce combat, a sudden, mighty blast from behind sweeps away the surrounding enemies.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Legion...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: No, this isn't coming from me...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: This power is—?!
[Void Scene] Zoya's image darkens

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...I'm feeling weightless... My injuries are mending... What's going on, is this ${PlayerName}'s doing?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Hecate?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What are you doing here?! Is that thing a... dragon—?
Nightmare seems to grow in size, suddenly sprouting wings from its back.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...What are you doing here? What about that dummy, shouldn't you be with him?
steps.female_content: ...What are you doing here? What about that dummy, shouldn't you be with her?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Are you sure you can take this alone?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...I'm fine now.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I haven't been alone for a long time.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The boy clutches the candy vending machine instinctively and flinches. He looks at Crache, then at you, and answers after a moment of hesitation.
steps.female_content: Chief will be fine on her own, I believe in her. So—

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I'm here to protect Hella.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: ...The Black Ring is experiencing major disturbances, the Corruptors are lost in disarray, and some of the Mania Infected are coming to their senses... What's going on? Could it be... that Chief's back?

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Anyways, this is an rare opportunity! Halt the retreat, all FAC units, gather up. It's time to take down the Corruptors. I'll take full responsibility for any disciplinary consequences, but try your best to keep the civilians safe! Move out!!
[CG: The Black Ring and the Tower Aflame]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's enough, the quiet masses of Syndicate.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've seen yourselves as the downtrodden, the weak, and the helpless. You've been numbed for far too long, escaping for far too long.
steps.female_content: You've seen yourselves as the downtrodden, the weak, and the helpless. You've been numbed for far too long, escaping for far too long.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Waiting for leaders, heroes, or even fate to step in and right your wrongs.
steps.female_content: Waiting for leaders, heroes, or even fate to step in and right your wrongs.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've only been watching them, the strong and the weak alike, turning themselves into beacons, forging the bloodstained path.
steps.female_content: You've only been watching them, the strong and the weak alike, turning themselves into beacons, forging the bloodstained path.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now, it's your turn to step up.
steps.female_content: Now, it's your turn to step up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Everyone gets a chance, and everyone faces a choice.
steps.female_content: Everyone gets a chance, and everyone faces a choice.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stop living in the shadows of self-pity. Stop waiting for someone else to save you. It's time to face the Black Ring head-on.
steps.female_content: Stop living in the shadows of self-pity. Stop waiting for someone else to save you. It's time to face the Black Ring head-on.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This time, it's up to you to shape your destiny.
Please give me your answer.
